fact: Law 210/AN/25/9eme L approves the 2024 accounts of ANSIE, the state digital agency: 479.2m DJF of charges against 457.1m DJF of income; the agency's own accounts, covering both income and charges.

The Council of Ministers approved ANSIE's (state digital agency) 2026 budget at 396,120,056 DJF, of which 108.1m DJF is investment (firewalls, archiving, datacentre backup, X-Road support); revenue is mainly the state subvention.
ANSIE's 2026 budget of 396.1m DJF is down 160.6m DJF from 556.7m DJF in 2025, a fall of about 29%, which the record ties to the creation of a separate National Cybersecurity Authority.
Budget tables: 479,221,862 DJF is published as actually spent on digital lines for exercice 2024. Dated by the document that gives the figure.
Budget tables: the budget for exercice 2026 gives 485,686,344 DJF to 1 digital line(s). Dated by the budget document.

Budget tables: the 1 digital line(s) held in both years total 485,686,344 DJF for exercice 2026 against 456,943,040 for exercice 2025, +6.3 per cent; 1 lines are held for exercice 2026. Dated by the budget document.
